scope_rule: Helpers that already exist do not shrink OC-01 through OC-06. A compiled pack, a ledger row, a description commit, or a caller-supplied gate file is not the main chain.

rows.requirement: Approved 100k PG source becomes schema-valid OOS YAML on disk: ontology.yaml and generated/. JSON and Markdown stay compile products.
rows.present_today: createBuild through getBuildPack return JSON. pg-builder catalog, profile, comments, seal, cards, curated, approve, generate, review, pack, and pack-combined call write_json. approve sets authenticated false.
rows.not_a_substitute: An S5 JSON response, a card document, or a compiled pack.
rows.required_marker: not a requirement; the success schema fields decide
rows.input: Verified management session, build_id, and the server source seal. No caller YAML and no caller pack bytes.
rows.output: ontology/ontology.yaml with spec_version oos/v1, plus generated dataset, relationship, enum, and candidate YAML with schema_version oos/v1. Each file has its own sha256, schema hash, and evidence hash. table_row_counts are per table. The approved fixture is shop.party 2000, shop.account 8000, and shop.entry 90000. Their sum is 100000. That sum is not written as every file row_count.
rows.acceptance: parse_ontology_yaml and parse_dataset_yaml accept the bytes. A second read returns the same hashes.
rows.test: tools/ontology-lifecycle/tests/oracle.rs live pins and marker absence

rows.requirement: A real permissioned approve, reject, and defer writes reviews/decisions.yaml and the curated overlay, then the approved compiler builds effective output and reseals.
rows.present_today: decideReviewItem stores a ledger decision. The result keeps ledger_authenticated false, published false, and grants not_authorized. compileBuildPack keeps compiled_pack not_published. oo-core merge_effective is a library rule, not this HTTP result.
rows.not_a_substitute: pg-builder approve, a review-ledger receipt, or field_candidates_applied false.
rows.required_marker: not a requirement; the success schema fields decide
rows.input: Three decideReviewItem calls with choice approve, reject, and defer. Each binds candidate_sha256, source_sha256, identity revision, and the verified subject. Then compileEffectiveYaml for that build only.
rows.output: reviews/decisions.yaml, curated overlay YAML, and effective YAML. Approve text is visible. Reject is removed. Defer is not in curated. A stale override is a review item. field_candidates_applied is true and reseal_count is at least 1. A later builder run does not change curated hashes.
rows.acceptance: List identity is name, id, code, term, metric, dataset, entity, or item. Array index is not identity. Curated wins field by field. status rejected removes the effective item. Generated bytes do not overwrite curated bytes.

rows.requirement: The reviewed overlay and config become one immutable Git commit by compare-and-swap.
rows.present_today: Commit d04da89ff adds CLI apply-reviewed-tree. Request schema d2b63c5f81fbcdbb47c6d27cd4128e52b1e0240e3637fabaaadd36f3e635c7ac requires protocol, project_root, ref, expected_head, idempotency_key, project_id, revision, csrf, review_scope, ontology_blob, decisions_blob, and curated[{dataset, blob}]. Receipt schema e657b1274f1003d8e6b44d271ffd8649237cc5e23674ac692fc88564add098c5 requires authenticated const true, new_commit (40 hex or null), new_tree, old_commit, old_tree, ontology_blob, and decisions_blob. There is no method, path, or required_response line. new_commit null is outcome unchanged. E57 sections in the same file still say authenticated false. Dirty src/git.rs, src/lib.rs, and untracked src/reviewed.rs are not this pin. This crate does not spawn the CLI.
rows.not_a_substitute: operationId applyReviewedTree as a line, an E57 description commit, a null new_commit, or a process spawn.
rows.required_marker: not a requirement; the success schema fields decide
rows.input: A loopback method and path under /control/. The body carries expected_head, an idempotency key, ontology_blob, decisions_blob, and curated dataset blob ids from the prior edge. No raw YAML, no caller approval, and no process spawn.
rows.output: update-ref compare-and-swap. The success body has authenticated true, a non-null commit id, a tree id, the previous head, ontology_blob, decisions_blob, and the curated blob ids. Restart reads that same commit. A mismatched expected_head leaves the ref in place.
rows.acceptance: No push and no overwrite on conflict. The E57 receipt is not this edge. A CLI stdin process is not this edge.

rows.requirement: That same Git commit becomes an immutable release candidate. Required G1-G13, the role fence, replay, and active CAS run. A missing safety gate does not publish.
rows.present_today: createRelease loads an operator pack file and a gates file named by config_commit. production_ready, customer_gate_verified, owner_authenticated, and runsc_verified are SQL false. certificate_class is not_issued or test_scope_not_production. release-coordinator production_admissible returns false at decide.rs sha256 439aa2112925934c7f448f98a220fb889b708cb27fd1c7aa214b21a4d75496f4.
rows.not_a_substitute: A compiled pack with published false, or a gates.json written by this lifecycle crate.
rows.required_marker: not a requirement; the success schema fields decide
rows.input: The OC-03 commit id, one role, scope test_scope or production, and the verified session. The caller uploads neither gates nor pack bytes.
rows.output: A result for G1, G2, G3, G4, G5a, G5b, G6, G7, G8, G9, G10, G11, G12, and G13, plus the role fence, replay, and the active pointer CAS. Unmet external gates stay not production. A test-scope activation is certificate_class test_scope_not_production.
rows.acceptance: production is not rewritten to test_scope. A missing safety gate does not move the active pointer. compiled_pack is not publication.

rows.requirement: The agent reads the role pack of the current active release, and the query tool cites that pack.
rows.archive: untracked worktree, not a git commit. Observed SHA-256 51876a007ec288e0e8c094445e895e38bc9663e0eeaf3840e6acbf842a10063e after a same-phase move from 1484189f995e8404d3c2fc381c258418a31e2c4a819135f7ba227b61be001aba. Pin not moved.
rows.present_today: Re-read the untracked file. It contains the line operationId bindActiveReleasePack and prose that createSession pack_sha256 should equal getActiveRolePack. POST /entry/v1/sessions 201 text names pack_sha256. It does not require active_release_id, source_commit, policy_sha256, knowledge_sha256, and content_sha256 as one success schema. POST /v1/query is private_fixed. The file is not a fixed commit, so this edge is unpinned and is not called.
rows.not_a_substitute: A marker line, a compiled pack that was not activated, private_fixed bytes, or an untracked contract.
rows.required_marker: not a requirement; the success schema fields decide
rows.input: The active release operation id, role, pack sha256, source git commit, policy, knowledge, and content hash returned by getActiveRolePack.
rows.output: createSession pack_sha256 equals that active digest. The query audit names that pack. Columns hidden for the other role stay absent. Revocation changes the digest and the old pack is refused.
rows.acceptance: published false or a missing active release is HTTP 409 pack_unpublished.

rows.requirement: One private 100k-row journey ties YAML, decisions, Git, the candidate, the active release, and the agent pack. Model failure, CAS conflict, restart, stale override, and revoke have no forbidden side effects.
rows.present_today: Blocked until OC-01 through OC-05 are real producer operations on a fixed commit. This crate does not start PostgreSQL and does not call a model in order to invent that proof.
rows.not_a_substitute: A unit test that this process writes no file.
rows.required_marker: OC-01 through OC-05 executed on one source seal
rows.input: The same private source with 2000, 8000, and 90000 rows. No enterprise source.
rows.output: The YAML hash, decision hash, git commit, candidate hash, active release, and agent pack hash match on every edge.
rows.acceptance: Model failure does not change review, Git, or publication. A CAS conflict does not move the ref. Stale input and revocation are refused.
